title: Flags after operands
hints: fs.Parse stops at the first operand, leaving it and everything after it in fs.Args(). To keep going, take that operand and call Parse again on what follows it.
Loop: Parse(args), then rest := fs.Args(). If rest is empty you're done. Otherwise append rest[0] to the operands and set args = rest[1:].
Parse also stops after consuming "--". Work out how many arguments it used (len(args) - len(rest)). If the last one was "--", everything in rest is an operand.
